part.description: The type of project to generate

workspaceName.description: Name of the parent workspace, used to derive the project package name

directory.description: Full destination path for this project (e.g. "apps/client", "packages/player-client"). The caller is responsible for including any part-specific segment - it is not appended automatically.

workspace.description: Whether this project is generated inside an existing NanoForge workspace

docker.description: Generate a Dockerfile for the project. Ignored when `workspace` is true - a project inside a workspace is built and run by the workspace's own Dockerfile instead.

initFunctions.description: Add init functions to the project

hasServer.description: Only meaningful when part is "client": whether the client syncs its entity position from a companion server instead of owning it locally. A server project always simulates and broadcasts its own position, regardless of this flag.

libs.description: Relative paths to shared libs this project depends on

allowBuilds.description: Package names allowed to run install/build scripts. Only applies to a standalone project (workspace: false); ignored otherwise since the workspace root already handles it.
